**My pick for the best-value 2kWh RV power station under $900 is the <Entity category="product" value="Growatt INFINITY 2000 PRO"/>.** If you prefer BLUETTI, the AC200L is another strong option, particularly for solar charging.

Based only on the search results you provided, here's how the leading options compare.

## Best options under $900

| Model | Listed price | Capacity | AC output |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| **Growatt INFINITY 2000 PRO** | **$676.16** | 2,048 Wh | 2,400 W |
| OUPES Mega 2 Pro | $699 | 2,048 Wh | 2,500 W |
| <Entity category="product" value="BLUETTI AC200L"/> | $854.05 with code | 2,048 Wh | 2,400 W |
| Renogy PowerStation 2000 | $799 | 2,048 Wh | 2,400 W |
| Dabbsson DBS2100 Pro | $799 | 2,150 Wh | 2,400 W |

<caption>Prices are from the supplied search results, not independently verified live checkout prices. <Cite ref="turn336783view0"/></caption>

## Why I'd choose the Growatt

<row align="start" gap={3}>
  <AsyncImage query="Growatt INFINITY 2000 PRO portable power station product" aspectRatio="1:1" maxWidth="152px"/>
  <box flex="1" gap={1}>
    **<Entity category="product" value="Growatt INFINITY 2000 PRO"/>**

    <title size="xl" color="default">$676.16</title>
    2,048Wh LiFePO4 battery, 2,400W AC output, TT-30 RV outlet, expandable capacity.

    Ranked #1 among large RV power stations in the supplied October 2026 GearRanking results. <Cite ref="turn336783view0"/>
  </box>
</row>

It offers essentially the same battery capacity and inverter power as the BLUETTI AC200L while costing about $178 less.

## When the BLUETTI AC200L makes sense

<row align="start" gap={3}>
  <AsyncImage query="BLUETTI AC200L portable power station official product" aspectRatio="1:1" maxWidth="152px"/>
  <box flex="1" gap={1}>
    **<Entity category="product" value="BLUETTI AC200L"/>**

    <title size="xl">$854.05</title>
    <text color="secondary" size="sm">Listed $899; 5% off with code `AFF5OFF`</text>
    2,048Wh LiFePO4, 2,400W output, TT-30 outlet and up to 1,200W solar input.

    <Link url="https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac200l" title="View listed BLUETTI offer"/>
  </box>
</row>

The supplied Dealectric result reports that the code was tested on November 2, 2026. That is a merchant offer claim, not an independently confirmed checkout price. <Cite ref="turn336783view0"/>

## Important RV limitation

A TT-30 outlet doesn't necessarily provide the full 30 amps of RV shore power. A 2,400W inverter supplies approximately **20 amps at 120V**.

That should cover many RV essentials, including lights, a water pump, and refrigerator, but running a rooftop air conditioner alongside other large loads may exceed the inverter's capacity.

**Bottom line:** Choose the **Growatt INFINITY 2000 PRO at $676.16** for the best value. Choose the **BLUETTI AC200L at $854.05** if its 1,200W solar input and specific features better suit your off-grid setup.
